about_the_game:
In life, you were a legendary hero. Now you'll rise from the grave as a ghost to defend your country in its hour of greatest need! Defy dragons, duel the dead, and dive to the depths of the sea in this haunted fantasy epic.

Specters of the Deep is an interactive novel by Abigail C. Trevor. It's entirely text-based, without graphics or sound effects, and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.

You were once the finest warrior the island nation of Galdrin ever knew. You protected the people, befriended the dragons, and defended the crown. But you fell in battle at the hands of your greatest rival, dead before your time. So your story ended—until you awake, centuries later, to find yourself rising from your tomb to save Galdrin once more.

But the Galdrin of the present is not the one you once knew. The royal family is shattered and divided, clinging to scraps of their former power. New enemies are rising within and without, shouting in the streets and sailing the sea. The dragons are withdrawing from the alliance you built. And you aren't the only specter on Galdrin's shores. There's an army of ghosts crawling out of the water, tearing at the foundations of the castle. Sometimes, you can hear the voice that commands them. Something's waiting at the bottom of the ocean that surrounds you—and you think it wants you back.

  • Play as male, female, or non-binary; gay, straight, bisexual, monogamous, polyamorous, asexual, and/or aromantic

  • Float above the ground, walk through walls, and commune with the dead

  • Romance a troubled king, a rebellious prince, a clever wizard, a daring dragon, or a familiar ghost

  • Search the sea for lost treasure and buried secrets

  • Build a new body, or embrace your spectral form

  • Swear your eternal loyalty to the crown, or choose a new master

  • Reunite with old friends—and old foes

What nightmare lies in the deep?
